title: WorkPass44 implementation ledger and next integration queue

completedThisPass.title: Stable execution identity and provider-facing idempotency context
completedThisPass.evidence: ActionGateway keyed execution derives stable executionId and hashed idempotency token; execution context includes decisionId/autonomous. Crash tests show pending/uncertain operations are not blindly repeated. Provider-side honoring remains separate/open.
completedThisPass.nextStep: Implement and demonstrate adapter-specific provider/device propagation.

completedThisPass.title: Unknown verification is not contradictory/negative learning
completedThisPass.evidence: Causal graph only creates contradiction from explicit negative verification; missing/unverified observation remains unknown. Regression covers semantic distinction.

completedThisPass.title: OrganismCore external observations become exact CEF causal evidence nodes
completedThisPass.evidence: External observations correlate to one exact execution/outcome, persist as separate external-evidence nodes with hashed/sanitized payload, and use deterministic IDs/replay semantics. OrganismCore integration test verifies parent and raw-postcondition omission.

completedThisPass.title: CEF snapshot restore validates external evidence references and hashes
completedThisPass.evidence: Restore keeps external evidence refs only when the target node, executionId, observationId and projection hash match; dangling/forged references are discarded.

completedThisPass.title: Temporal credit outcome replay cannot double-reward
completedThisPass.evidence: CanonicalTemporalCreditAuthority stores outcomeId/decisionId, returns no new assignments for exact replay and rejects ID conflicts; snapshot/restore retains identities.

completedThisPass.title: External observation assessments and source trust are replay-safe
completedThisPass.evidence: ExternalObserverFabric reuses a stored assessment rather than incrementing source counters again; ExternalEvidenceTrust binds updates to evidenceId and rejects conflicting reuse.

completedThisPass.title: P84 autobiography/behavior continuity and P83 beliefs ignore duplicate observations
completedThisPass.evidence: P84 ingestion and verified-outcome learning accept bounded idempotency/evidence IDs persisted in snapshots. P83 does not increase continuity/confidence for an already-applied observation ID.

completedThisPass.title: MemoryFabric aged-out mutation receipt keys fail closed
completedThisPass.evidence: Bloom tombstones record keys retired from the exact 512-entry journal; possible old-key reuse requires reconciliation; malformed/corrupt tombstone state fails closed for unknown mutations. Migration and lifecycle regressions pass.
completedThisPass.nextStep: Monitor false-positive rate and define explicit administrative reconciliation tooling before deployment to high-write workloads.

partial.title: Real provider/device honors passed stable idempotency token
partial.evidence: ActionGateway exposes deterministic executionId plus provider-facing hashed token to the executor, and local crash tests pass. No real provider/device adapter has yet demonstrated provider-side idempotency or receipt lookup.
partial.nextStep: Update each external adapter to forward the token and retrieve authoritative receipt after ambiguous disconnect.

partial.title: Delayed external evidence drives a real-provider reafference/credit path
partial.evidence: Existing deterministic reafference integration and new CEF/temporal credit replay tests pass locally; the full delayed signal from a real external provider after disconnect/restart is not yet exercised.
partial.nextStep: Exercise real adapter accepted→disconnect→reconnect→evidence→credit flow end to end.

next.title: Provider/device receipt reconnect and ambiguous-outcome reconciliation E2E
next.evidence: No authoritative provider/device end-to-end run has been recorded.
next.nextStep: Run on a real integration endpoint with crash injection before effect, after effect, before local commit and after restart.

next.title: Dependency-installed Vite build and browser Live2D/Legacy E2E
next.evidence: App dependencies are absent; static JS/UI contracts are not equivalent to a real browser session.
next.nextStep: Install dependencies in a supported environment and run production build, browser launch, Legacy/Live2D switch, iframe origin and restore scenarios.

next.title: Close release gates: target inference, holdout, rollback, licenses and soak
next.evidence: Target-host inference, independent labelled temporal retrieval uplift, clean-room rollback, nested source license sign-off and long soak remain unconfirmed. Retrieval uplift remains zero and its candidate is not promoted.
next.nextStep: Close each gate with dated evidence before recalculating the official weighted score.

nextPassPriorityQueue.task: Pass ToolExecutionContext.idempotencyKey through real HTTP/SDK device/provider adapters and persist provider request/reference ID alongside canonical receipt.
nextPassPriorityQueue.acceptance: A provider-accepted action followed by local disconnect/restart is recovered by authoritative lookup without a second provider side effect.

nextPassPriorityQueue.task: Complete real external evidence → CEF → reafference/temporal credit over a real provider/device integration.
nextPassPriorityQueue.acceptance: Evidence cites exact executionId and observationId; replay after restart produces no duplicate trust/reward/P84 revision; conflicts are rejected.

nextPassPriorityQueue.task: Run installed React/Vite production build and interactive browser Live2D/Legacy E2E.
nextPassPriorityQueue.acceptance: Clean app build; viewer load; iframe messages from trusted source pass; wrong origin/source/schema reject; Legacy fallback and restore function.

nextPassPriorityQueue.task: Run clean-room upgrade/rollback fault injection with source blobs and state backups.
nextPassPriorityQueue.acceptance: Injected failures at each phase restore exact bytes/state; no source-manifest drift or untracked deletions.

nextPassPriorityQueue.task: Measure target-host local inference and independent labelled temporal retrieval holdout.
nextPassPriorityQueue.acceptance: Record hardware, model, resources, cancellation; retrieval candidate promoted only with positive independently measured uplift.

nextPassPriorityQueue.task: Complete manual nested-license review and runtime soak.
nextPassPriorityQueue.acceptance: Every bundled source dependency has provenance/license disposition; soak logs include restarts, memory growth, errors and recovery.

scorePolicy: Do not increase the official 78.0% weighted roadmap score until external-provider, installed-app E2E, target-host, independent holdout, rollback, licensing and soak gates have evidence.
